blocks.text: Warner Bros. has released the final trailer of the third installment in the “Dune” film series, ahead of its premiere in cinemas in December. In the clip shared on the film studio’s social media pages on Wednesday, Oct. 28, lead star Timothee Chalamet’s Paul Atreides faces a conspiracy launched against him nearly two decades after the events in the previous film. Toward the end of the trailer, Atreides and Zendaya’s Chani come face to face again, with the latter declaring her opposition to him.
